scope: Complete manuscript-format threshold-only EDSS >=4 sensitivity package

threshold_change.canonical: EDSS > 3.0 (equivalent to EDSS >=3.5 in these data)

cohort_policy: Hold each canonical analysis cohort fixed and change only the EDSS threshold. Supplementary Table 5 retains RR047 in the frozen canonical lesion cohort (N=89); removing RR047 would conflate threshold and cohort changes.
multiplicity: Adjusted qMRI p-values use the manuscript-wide Bonferroni family m=98; exploratory m=14 values are not inserted into the manuscript-format package.
